jei.boiling-cauldron.bobo_soak.info: Put a soup base into the Bobo Chicken Pot to gain %s soaks. Each food becomes Bobo Chicken after soaking.
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.bamboo_fungus:
Dropped by Bamboo Fungus Colonies (2-3).
Colonies are spawned by the Bamboo Root on nearby soil.
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.bamboo_fungus_:
Spawned by the Bamboo Root on nearby soil.
Harvest with shears to obtain the block itself; otherwise it drops 2-3 Bamboo Fungus.
Compostable (0.65).
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.bamboo_root:
Does not generate naturally; crafted from 8 bamboo plus 1 dirt.
Once placed, it periodically spawns Winter Bamboo Shoot crops or Bamboo Fungus Colonies on soil within a 5x5 area, up to 5 alive at once.
More bamboo nearby raises the success chance (+1% each, capped at +20%).
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.blooming_lotus:
Generates naturally on the water surface of swamps and mangrove swamps.
Once it reaches growth stage 4 (mature), it periodically converts dirt, sand or gravel below into Lotus Mud.
Using bone meal on a mature leaf spreads it to adjacent water.
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.lotus_mud:
Does not generate naturally.
Created when a mature Blooming Lotus Leaf converts dirt, sand or gravel below it.
Right-click with a shovel for 3 Lotus Roots; mining drops 1-4.
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.lotus_root:
Obtained from Lotus Mud: right-click with a shovel for 3, or mine for 1-4.
Lotus Mud is formed when a mature Blooming Lotus Leaf converts the block below.
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.lush_grass:
Generates naturally on the surface of: plains, sunflower plains, forest, flower forest, birch forest, taiga, savanna, meadow, swamp, mangrove swamp.
At most one attempt per 4 chunks.
Harvest with shears to obtain the block itself; breaking it any other way has a 35% chance to drop a random crop seed from this mod.
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.seeds:
Obtained from:
- Lush Grass: 35% chance to drop a random seed
- Village chests: different seeds per village type, plus an 8% seasoning pack pool
- Wandering Trader: 1 emerald for 1 seed
jei.boiling-cauldron.info.winter_bamboo_:
Harvested from mature Winter Bamboo Shoot crops spawned by the Bamboo Root.
Using bone meal on a mature crop turns it into vanilla bamboo.
